author: parashara
text_original: पादप्रणामावनतं तम् उत्थाप्य पिता सुतम् । हिरण्यकशिपुः प्राह प्रह्लादम् अमितौजसम् ॥
text_iast: pādapraṇāmāvanataṃ tam utthāpya pitā sutam / hiraṇyakaśipuḥ prāha prahlādam amitaujasam
notes: Certified substantive Sanskrit alignment. The verse explicitly uses pitā/sutam and names Hiraṇyakaśipu and Prahlāda; Vedapath meanings/commentary are not ingested.

author: parashara
text_original: पितर्य् उपरतिं नीते नरसिंहस्वरूपिणा । विष्णुना सो ऽपि दैत्यानां मैत्रेयाभूत् पतिस् ततः ॥
text_iast: pitary uparatiṃ nīte narasiṃhasvarūpiṇā / viṣṇunā so 'pi daityānāṃ maitreyābhūt patis tataḥ
notes: Certified substantive Sanskrit alignment; the verse explicitly says Viṣṇu in Narasiṃha form and refers to Prahlāda's father. Vedapath meanings/commentary are not ingested.

author: parashara
text_original: एवं प्रभावो दैत्यो ऽसौ मैत्रेयासीन् महामतिः । प्रह्लादो भगवद्भक्तो यं त्वं माम् अनुपृच्छसि ॥
text_iast: evaṃ prabhāvo daityo 'sau maitreyāsīn mahāmatiḥ / prahlādo bhagavadbhakto yaṃ tvaṃ mām anupṛcchasi
notes: Certified substantive Sanskrit alignment; verse directly identifies Prahlāda as bhagavad-bhakta. Vedapath meanings/commentary are not ingested.

author: parashara
text_original: प्रह्लादं सकलापत्सु यथा रक्षितवान् हरिः । तथा रक्षति यस् तस्य शृणोति चरितं सदा ॥
text_iast: prahlādaṃ sakalāpatsu yathā rakṣitavān hariḥ / tathā rakṣati yas tasya śṛṇoti caritaṃ sadā
notes: Certified substantive Sanskrit alignment; verse directly states that Hari protected Prahlāda. Vedapath meanings/commentary are not ingested.
